notes: Local source-derived emulation, not a hardware/browser capture. This profile models the earlier CRKD Mode 1 preset identified by YARG as CrkdGuitar_Mode1, before firmware 3 changed star power to D-pad left.
Use the Multi-platform Gibson Les Paul CK25GM; Nitro Deck is a separate Switch controller product.
Stock Windows XInputGetStateEx availability is assumed for button 16. Without it Chromium exposes 16 buttons; that separate variant is omitted.

All unpressed buttons, including whammy and unused RT, are modeled at zero; those physical resting bytes are inferred. The tested conversion patch supports whammy LT with rest zero, but no raw browser rest dump was located.
Whammy is analog button 6 (0..1), not an axis. D-pad and strum share standard button indices; there is no numeric hat axis or independent tilt axis in this preset.

Browser indices: 0 A/Green; 1 B/Red; 2 X/Blue; 3 Y/Yellow; 4 LB/Orange; 5 RB (physical alias unconfirmed); 6 LT/Whammy; 7 RT (physical alias unconfirmed); 8 View/Select/CTRL inferred; 9 Menu/Start; 10 L3; 11 R3; 12 D-pad/Strum up; 13 D-pad/Strum down; 14 D-pad left; 15 D-pad right; 16 Home/Guide. Axes 0/1 Left stick; 2/3 Right stick, nominal rest inferred.
The dual-rumble object is Chromium's unconditional XInput API exposure. It does not confirm browser-controlled physical vibration or equate to the guitar's local strum haptics.
Chromium XInput id hides VID/PID. Hardware-tested old Mode 1 uses 045e:028e; newer native CRKD IDs from Linux/SDL are not transplanted into this earlier profile.
Factory names whose report is unknown are omitted or explicitly unreported. Capture, firmware/current platform modes and remapped presets need real captures.
